summary: Email research for Artist Commission Form MVP - Top 2 target buyers with multiple contacts each

target_buyers.fit_rationale: Multi-arts nonprofit offering year-round programming in theater, dance, music, and visual arts with rotating monthly gallery exhibits featuring local, regional, and national artists. Commission form platform would streamline their artist submission process and connect exhibiting artists with potential buyers seeking custom work.

target_buyers.fit_rationale: Curated platform listing art calls, grants, fellowships, jobs, and exhibition spaces for Northeast Ohio artists. Artist commission functionality would complement their existing opportunities database and provide another revenue stream for local artists.

target_buyers.research_notes: Single-founder operation run by Susan Snipes. No organizational email found - contact goes directly to founder. Platform serves visual artists exclusively in Northeast Ohio (Akron, Canton, Cleveland, Lorain, Youngstown). Weekly newsletter has 1,654+ Instagram followers. Highly targeted audience for commission platform integration.
